distractors.name: pdf-handler
distractors.description: Read, merge, split, and extract text or tables from PDF files, or produce a new PDF from supplied content.

distractors.name: sheet-wrangler
distractors.description: Open, clean, and transform spreadsheet and CSV data; add formulas, pivot summaries, and formatting to workbook files.

distractors.name: deck-builder
distractors.description: Build slide decks and presentations from an outline, with layouts, speaker notes, and consistent styling.

distractors.name: commit-writer
distractors.description: Write clear commit messages from a staged diff, following conventional commit style with a short subject and explanatory body.

distractors.name: code-reviewer
distractors.description: Review a code change for defects, risky patterns, and maintainability problems, and report prioritized comments.

distractors.name: test-author
distractors.description: Write unit and integration tests for existing functions, covering edge cases and failure paths.

distractors.name: sql-helper
distractors.description: Compose, explain, and optimize SQL queries against a relational database schema.

distractors.name: web-researcher
distractors.description: Search the web for a question, compare several sources, and summarize the findings with citations.

distractors.name: photo-editor
distractors.description: Crop, resize, recolor, and retouch images, or remove backgrounds from pictures.

distractors.name: translator
distractors.description: Translate text between languages while keeping tone, terminology, and formatting intact.

distractors.name: email-drafter
distractors.description: Draft and polish emails and replies for a stated audience, tone, and purpose.

distractors.name: chart-maker
distractors.description: Turn tabular data into charts and dashboards, choosing suitable chart types, scales, and colors.

distractors.name: doc-writer
distractors.description: Write and restructure technical documentation, such as READMEs, guides, and API reference pages.

distractors.name: dependency-upgrader
distractors.description: Upgrade project dependencies to newer versions, resolve breaking changes, and update lockfiles.

distractors.name: bug-hunter
distractors.description: Diagnose a failing program by reproducing the problem, tracing the cause, and proposing a minimal fix.
